pr_title: Shake exports with pure property assignments
pr_body:
Fixes #2909.

For example, assigning a `displayName` to a function is pretty common in react code, and does not cause side effects.

issue_context.title: Why the production bundle size is significantly larger that create-react-app
issue_context.body:
I did a very simple experiment with the following settings index.html (used for `parcel-bundler` only as `create-react-app` creates one automatically) ```html
``` index.js (also used in the project initialized with `create-react-app`) ```jsx import React from 'react' import ReactDOM from 'react-dom' import { FaBeer } from 'react-icons/fa' const App = () => (

Let's have some !

) ReactDOM.render(, document.getElementById('root')) ``` `./node_modules/.bin/parcel --version` 1.12.3 `./node_modules/.bin/parcel build index.html` While in a separate project initialized with create-react-app (2.1.8), the bundle size is way much smaller ![cra-build-after-gzip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1152119/55834155-397dc600-5ae7-11e9-9529-8df0a76799c1.png) Without gzip: ![cra-build](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1152119/55834174-43072e00-5ae7-11e9-9060-f803101b657f.png) Nodejs version: 8.14.1 OS: Mac OSX Mojave Can someone tell me why the bundle size difference is so significant? Are there any options I can use to improve/reduce the bundle size using parcel?

error: unknown option `--experimental-tree-shaking'
```
